what: a ring profile (radii 79.815 and 78.285) swept along a 22.5 degree arc of radius 94.815 whose start is at the ring centre, joined to a ring-shaped collar under the profile (froze at "Computing")
method: the ring section is square to the path and centred on it, and its radius is below the bend radius, so the sweep is a tube segment: V = A_ring R theta, A_ring = pi (79.815^2 - 78.285^2). The collar is the same ring extruded 10 mm down, touching the sweep start face: V = A_ring (10 + 94.815 * 22.5 deg).
